title: "New Saucer Photos" page and Oakland Tribune "Flying Saucers Are Poppin' Up All Over"
description: Two-page spread. The left page shows six photographs of disc- and dome-shaped objects over trees and desert, captioned "NEW SAUCER PHOTOS: These remarkable photos of Flying Saucers were taken by Dr. Daniel W. Fry..." and noting the craft was photographed near Merlin, Oregon and near Joshua Tree, Calif. The right page is an Oakland Tribune clipping collage headlined "Flying Saucers Are Poppin' Up All Over" and "40 See 'Flying Saucer'," with headlines such as "Air Force UFO report refuted" and "Mystery Objects in Sky," plus photos, a cartoon, a diagram of a saucer, and a "Brewer Welcomes UFO's" sign.
